summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload at install time
details: The package's preinstall script (node setup.mjs) downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/ into a temporary directory and then invokes it via execFileSync to execute a shipped 727 KB single-line file, math_init.js. math_init.js is heavily obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style _0xXXXX identifiers, a WV8StW string-array rotator over a large mixed numeric/string constant table, // @bun @bun-cjs header) with no readable source, no exported API, and no relation to the package's advertised trivial functionality (a `Hello ${name}` string in dist/index-node18.mjs). Using a separately-fetched non-Node runtime to execute the obfuscated blob bypasses Node-based install-time scanners on the installer. The combination — install-time fetch of an alternate runtime, execution of an obfuscated sibling payload unrelated to the declared purpose, and cover-story minimal library content — matches the alternate-runtime dropper attack pattern and results in arbitrary attacker-controlled code executing on any developer or CI host that runs `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
